title: Scalar transport and reaction operators
summary: Provides inspectable advection, scalar Burgers convection, streamline-upwind stabilization, and named scalar reaction laws for reusable transport and reaction--diffusion workflows.

science.statement: Transport and reaction semantics remain named public operators while UFL supplies the executable weak form and differentiation.

equations.label: multidimensional scalar Burgers transport
equations.description: The default public direction differentiates the transported scalar along every spatial axis; a caller may supply an explicit direction for a reduced model.

equations.label: advection--diffusion--reaction
equations.description: Diffusion, directed transport, and local reaction remain independently inspectable contributions.

equations.label: streamline-upwind contribution
equations.description: SUPG weights the strong residual in the streamline test direction.

equations.label: advective intrinsic scale
equations.description: The first public policy uses the cellwise advective scale and rejects zero velocity.

inputs.name: reaction law
inputs.description: Linear, cubic, Allen--Cahn, or logistic local reaction parameters.

inputs.name: strong residual
inputs.description: Complete equation residual supplied to streamline stabilization.

outputs.name: transport operator
outputs.description: Composable UFL form with family, method, and velocity metadata.

outputs.name: reaction expression
outputs.description: Local nonlinear term suitable for residual construction and automatic differentiation.

assumptions: The current intrinsic scale is the advective cell scale, not a universal transient or diffusion-aware stabilization policy.
Named reaction parameters use a unit-consistent model chosen by the caller.
SUPG requires the caller to provide the complete strong residual appropriate to the time discretization.
conventions: Reaction laws enter the balance with a positive residual sign.
Allen--Cahn is represented as lambda times (u cubed minus u).
Logistic reaction is represented as rho times u times (1 minus u).
applicability: Steady and transient scalar advection--diffusion, reaction--diffusion, phase-like scalar kinetics, and externally defined transport workflows.
limitations: No discontinuity-capturing or shock limiter is included.
The scalar operators do not define mixed flow, species coupling, or automatic stabilization selection.
Symbolic velocity metadata are recorded as an inspectable expression string rather than reconstructed as numeric components.

usage.minimal_example: Create A = operators.advection_operator(u, v, beta); add operators.streamline_upwind_operator(R, v, beta, domain=domain) when the declared transport policy requires SUPG.

validation_rules: Reject a zero numeric advection velocity when constructing the advective intrinsic time scale.
Keep official benchmark oracle data outside the adapter and regression tests.

references.title: Streamline upwind/Petrov-Galerkin formulations for convection dominated flows
